get.description: All time unless a range is given.
All time unless a range is given.

LaunchGood records the Gift Aid flag per donation; JustGiving only gives
its own page-level estimate, reported separately.
Gross vs net per month. LaunchGood only: JustGiving doesn't report fees.
JustGiving pages that have a target. LaunchGood exports don't include one.
Donations by day of week and hour, in UK time.
Followers gained or lost per period, from the last reading in each period.
How each format performs: Reel vs image vs carousel vs TikTok video.
Average engagement rate by day of week and hour posted, in UK time.
Instagram account-level activity over time (TikTok's access doesn't give this).

Latest follower demographics. Shares are of the followers the platform
could classify, which can be well under the total follower count.

Subscribes and unsubscribes per period. Mailchimp's daily figures count
form sign-ups only: contacts added by hand or imported don't appear.
Monthly subscribed, unsubscribed, cleaned (dead) addresses, and bounces.

When supporters open and click: by hours after sending (averaged across
campaigns) and by hour of day in UK time (totals).
A chosen window (e.g. Ramadan) against the same-length window before it.

Donations on the day of each email and the day after, against a typical
two days in the weeks before it. A pattern to look at, not proof the
email caused the donations.
The caller's user ID, organisation and role.

Placeholder TikTok OAuth redirect (Sandbox). Public: TikTok calls it.
Must check `state` once it exchanges tokens. Doesn't echo the code.

{"period": "2026-10-01", "justgiving": 210.0, "launchgood": 40.0}.
